landing.title: Weekly staff rotas for UK bars and restaurants
landing.pitch: Build the week, publish it, and every Staff Member confirms their Shifts from a private link. No app to install, and staff never need to log in.

build.title: Build the week
build.body: Add your Staff Members and drop Shifts onto the week. Copy Last Week fills a new week in one click.

publish.title: Publish it
publish.body: Publishing puts the week's Shifts on each Staff Member's private Staff Link. Change a Shift later and they see what changed.

confirm.title: Staff confirm
confirm.body: Staff Members open their link on their phone and confirm or decline each Shift, saying why if they decline. You see every answer on the Rota.

free.name: Free
free.description: Everything you need to run one Venue's Rota.
free.rotas: Weekly Rotas, Publish, Copy Last Week and Send Updates
free.responses: Staff confirm or decline from their Staff Link
free.copyLinks: Copy each Staff Member's Staff Link to send it yourself

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: For busier Venues, or more than one.
pro.notifications: Rota Ready emails each Staff Member their Staff Link on Publish, and what changed on Send Updates
pro.reminders: An email Reminder the day before each Shift
pro.texts: Optional texts for notifications and Reminders, paid per text, up to a monthly limit you set
pro.venues: More than one Venue, all in one place
pro.managers: More than one Manager per Venue
